notes: The harvesters in the Orchard become neutral after completing the quest The Harvest Heart, regardless of which side was picked.

Massive harvesters can be seen in the background of the Atoll of Immolation, the Deadlands zone, and Doomchar Plateau, slithering along in the lava. Some can also be seen fighting against similarly massive Ruinachs.

North of Caterwaul Cove Wayshrine, Deetra Grotto, Worm Cult camp west of Gristmung Hold Harvesters are powerful Daedra most commonly found serving Molag Bal, although they serve Hircine and Sanguine too. Mehrunes Dagon has his own variant of Harvesters that can be encountered in the Deadlands and Rockgrove.
